note: Both sets bind many dimension strings to invented properties (web/flange thickness, base block, base plate, beam, middle section) that the drawing never labels, and each has about the same number of unsupported claims. Set B is stronger on the facts it does establish: it correctly captures the L3X3X1/4 support angle designation (repeated three times on the sheet), the 3/8" through-bolt diameter, the 1 1/2"=1'-0" scale, and the Module A/B segment lengths (2'-11 7/8", 3'-8 3/8") with correct left/right conditions. Set A gets the Module A segments 2'-3 7/8" and 7'-0" and the 10'-3 3/4" Module B length right, but it omits the L3X3X1/4 angle spec entirely and pads its set with vague 'dimension' entries and duplicated base block/base component guesses. Set B's clearest error is assigning 2'-3 7/8" to Module B when it belongs to Module A, but overall it yields more correct, useful claims.
